

# setup.exe is all Rust (setup-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/setup-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The translated C stays on disk; only rust_cohab_stub.c is compiled, in the OBJECT library the cargo
# link replays.
add_library(setup_shims OBJECT
    # setup.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/setup-rust/src/setup/setup.rs)
    rust_cohab_stub.c
    )
target_link_libraries(setup_shims PRIVATE libuserenv libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(setup_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(setup setup-cargo setup.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE setup-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS setup_shims psdk)
